import { AddUserForm } from "@/features/users/components/AddUserForm"

export function AddUserDialog() {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button className="shrink-0" />}>
        <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
        {m.users_add()}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{m.users_add()}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{m.users_add_description()}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <AddUserForm />
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

import type { UserRole } from "@/features/users/schemas/user.schema"

export const USERS_PATH = "/users"
export const USERS_PAGE_SIZE = 10
export const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300

export const ROLE_BADGE_CLASS_NAMES: Record<UserRole, string> = {
  admin: "border-transparent bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300",
  moderator: "border-transparent bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300",
  user: "border-transparent bg-muted text-foreground"
}

import { z } from "zod"

import * as m from "@/paraglide/messages.js"

export const userRoleSchema = z.enum(["admin", "moderator", "user"])

// Unknown keys are dropped on purpose: DummyJSON also returns passwords, bank and SSN fields.
export const userSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number(),
  firstName: z.string(),
  lastName: z.string(),
  username: z.string(),
  role: userRoleSchema.default("user"),
  // The list can hold people without a company.
  company: z.object({ title: z.string(), department: z.string() }).optional()
})

export const usersPageSchema = z.object({
  users: userSchema.array(),
  total: z.number(),
  skip: z.number(),
  limit: z.number()
})

// `error` is a function because this schema is built once, before any locale is known.
const tooLong = { error: () => m.users_error_too_long() }

export const userFormSchema = z.object({
  firstName: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.users_error_first_name() })
    .max(50, tooLong),
  lastName: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.users_error_last_name() })
    .max(50, tooLong),
  username: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.users_error_username() })
    .max(50, tooLong)
    .regex(/^[\w.-]+$/, { error: () => m.users_error_username_format() }),
  title: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.users_error_title() })
    .max(50, tooLong),
  department: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.users_error_department() })
    .max(50, tooLong),
  role: userRoleSchema
})

export const deletedUserSchema = z.object({ id: z.number() })

export type User = z.infer<typeof userSchema>
export type UserRole = z.infer<typeof userRoleSchema>
export type UsersPage = z.infer<typeof usersPageSchema>
export type UserFormInput = z.infer<typeof userFormSchema>

en.users_empty_description: The API returned an empty list.
en.users_add_description: Sends a real POST request to the DummyJSON demo API.
en.users_add_not_saved_reason: DummyJSON is a demo API: it returns the new user but does not store it, so the user will not appear in the list.
en.users_error_username_format: Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores
en.users_details_description: Shows the data already in the table, with no request.
en.users_edit_description: Sends a real PUT request to the DummyJSON demo API. It stores nothing, so the change lasts until the list loads again.
en.users_delete_description: Sends a real DELETE request to the DummyJSON demo API. It stores nothing, so the user comes back when the list loads again.
